<ParamField body="aria-label" type="string">
  Accessible navigation name. Defaults to Breadcrumb; supply a localized name or use aria-labelledby.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="className" type="string">
  Class merged onto the root navigation element.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="links" type="BreadcrumbItem[]" required>
  Ordered trail items with native anchor attributes, event handlers, ref, children and element or callback render composition. Items with href default to anchors; other items default to text. The final item defaults to aria-current="page". An explicit aria-current value is preserved, including false.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="ref" type="Ref&lt;HTMLElement&gt;">
  Ref to the root nav, or the DOM element supplied through render.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="render" type="ReactElement&lt;unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor&lt;any&gt;&gt; | ComponentRenderFn&lt;HTMLProps, {}&gt;">
  Caller-supplied root element or renderer. Preserve the navigation landmark and forward the supplied props and ref.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="style" type="CSSProperties">
  Inline styles applied to the root navigation element.
</ParamField>
